title: Bootsie Galbraith sees a UFO called in by Steven Greer

tellings.quote: She was in Mexico with Steven Greer and he called in a UFO and they all saw it.

plain: A woman named Bootsie Galbraith was in Mexico with a man named Steven Greer when, she said, he called in a UFO and everyone there saw it. Whitley Strieber, who says he has met aliens himself, repeats what Galbraith told him. If true, it would mean someone could summon a craft on purpose in front of witnesses.
